description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Kairi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kairi, adding {B}.
Kairi dies, triggering its ability granted by Feign Death and its other ability.
Resolve the first Kairi trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Kairi trigger, causing you to mill six cards and return Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
